title: the joysticks: a part you can wear out
fact: The type of joysticks that are commonly employed on game consoles are prone to wearing out and producing stick drift. Nintendo did not change this with the Nintendo Switch 2 (2025), despite alternative, drift-free sticks on the market.

title: The RAM and SSD: A shared mother, an AI-induced price explosion
fact: RAM and SSD are memory chips, and normally these would be pretty cheap chips, but thanks to the AI explosion, prices for these components have shot through the roof, and that means higher priced computers, including games consoles.

title: The battery: an enviromental and human rights nightmare
fact: A lithium-ion battery, an essential part of portable games consoles and most modern electronics, is a nightmare for both humans and the environment. Extraction of lithium and cobalt, child labour and unsafe conditions, in places like the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC)

title: The CPU: Electronics with potentially harmful minerals
fact: CPUs are electronics conponents, which rely on the production of 4 conflict minerals, tin, tungsten, tantalium and gold. These are often sourced from countries like the Congo, where it can be a potential source for funding of violence, corruption and human rights abuses. Nintendo says that 311 of its contracted smelters and refineries are compliant with its auditing policies, and only 1 refinery based in China was not compliant.
